author: Samsung
description:
Generation17 Young Leader Brigitta Gunawan is racing to save Indonesia's coral reefs before it's too late. Scientists warn that up to 90 % of coral reefs could be gone by 2050, so Brigitta is fighting back. The young marine conservationist leads two organizations—30x30 Indonesia and Diverseas—taking a dual approach to ocean conservation. Through 30x30 Indonesia, she's restoring coral reefs one fragment at a time, planting over 1,000 corals at underwater gardens in Bali. Through Diverseas, she's bringing the ocean to people who've never seen it, using VR headsets and 360-degree underwater films to inspire the next generation of ocean advocates. Her efforts have reached more than 17,000 people across 12 countries.
